notes: VAT general rate 21% since 1 Jan 2018 (raised from 19% by the 2017 amending law; confirmed in the Government press release). The VAT Law arts. 25-28 lists were read in the gov.me text: the only gold reliefs are supplies to, and imports by, the Central Bank - no public investment-gold scheme, so retail bullion takes 21%. Caveat: the amending law was not openable. Duty null.

sources.name: Government of Montenegro (gov.me) - Press release from the 33rd Cabinet session, 6 Jul 2017
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the adopted package increases the general VAT rate from 19% to 21% (in force 1 Jan 2018)
sources.quote: it is envisaged to increase the general VAT rate from 19% to 21%, while the lower rate applied to the trading of basic foodstuffs remains unchanged at the level of 7%

sources.name: Government of Montenegro (wapi.gov.me) - Law on Value Added Tax, cleared text, art. 27
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 27 item 6 exempts only supplies of gold and other precious metals to the Central Bank; arts. 25/26/28 contain no public investment-gold exemption
sources.quote: Supply of gold and other precious metals to the Central Bank of Montenegro;
